label: smoke: the direct-subtraction root-finding oracle beside subtract and mitm on a registered 20-bit prime-order curve
description: Correctness and plumbing check of rootfind-subtract (prime_fast's direct-subtraction root finding: every x(R ∓ F_i) of a target from one Montgomery batched inversion, RESEARCH_SEMAEV_ROOTFIND_VS_GROEBNER.md §2) against the subtract oracle, whose search it follows candidate for candidate, and the negation-folded mitm table, on the smoke-prime base, with rho.negation as the reference. The repository has no prime-curve Groebner decomposition oracle in ecbench (the note's Buchberger baseline terminates only at |F| = 6, too small to solve a DLP), so the prime comparison is against the existing table and subtraction oracles. Not a performance claim.
